title: ULTRAFEEDBACK: Boosting Language Models with Scaled AI Feedback

bias_targets.methodology: Switching the order of compared responses in prompts and averaging the scores from two runs to measure and eliminate the model's tendency to disproportionately prefer the first response.

Decomposing quality assessment into fine-grained aspects (instruction-following, truthfulness, honesty, helpfulness) and sampling completions from a diverse pool of models to alleviate spurious correlations between text styles, verbosity, and perceived response quality.
